Subject: Veridian integration HQ demo — scheduling & onsite logistics

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the walkthrough on the call yesterday. We'd like to schedule an in-person demo at Redwood HQ to validate the integration with our SSO and edge routing configs. Prefer the week of Sep 18 if possible.

Quick asks on our side:
- 90-minute slot (tech demo + Q&A)
- Projectors/HDMI + Mac adapter available?
- Two engineers + one procurement lead will attend (see attached attendee list)
- NDA/procurement paperwork — who should we send these to?

I attached a short attendee list and a high-level agenda. Can you confirm available times and any visitor requirements?

Best,
Alex Soto
Principal Integrations Manager
Veridian Systems

Hi Alex — great to hear you're able to make it in person. We can do the week of Sep 18. Current availability for the demo room is:
- Tue, Sep 19: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Wed, Sep 20: 13:30–15:00

We have a dual-display conference room with HDMI and USB-C adaptors; bring a Mac adapter just in case. AV will be confirmed by Marissa.

Visitor logistics and paperwork:
- We require NDAs for product/architecture-level demos. I will send a DocuSign link today to your email for signature.
- Please fill out a short visitor form (govt ID requested) before arrival to speed up badging.
- Parking: reserved visitor spaces are available; Marissa will add details.

Attaching our HQ visitor policy for reference. If you can confirm the final attendee names and preferred slot, I will lock the room and open the DocuSign NDA.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt

Hi all — looping in facilities and AV. Confirming we have the Redwood West conference room booked for Tue, Sep 19 14:00–15:30. AV notes:
- Dual 4K displays, HDMI + USB-C adapters on-site; Apple adapter not provided (please bring).
- Wired ethernet port in room for testing; public guest Wi-Fi is proxied and not suitable for SSO testing. If you need direct network access for the SSO handshake, facilities can arrange a temporary test VLAN — please confirm by Mon EOD.

Security/badging:
- To expedite entry, please send visitor full names and government ID type (driver license or passport). We will pre-print badges.
- Parking: two reserved visitor spots in Lot B (first-come). Directions attached.

I attached the latest demo runbook and the parking map. Looking forward to hosting you.

Thanks,

Thanks everyone — confirmed for Tue, Sep 19 14:00–15:30 in Redwood West. Final checklist and next steps:

1) NDA: DocuSign sent to Alex and Marcus. Please sign by Mon EOD so Security can proceed with pre-badging. Link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/abcd1234-veridian-nda
2) Visitor info: please reply to this thread with government ID type (DL/passport) and full legal names for each attendee. We need that by Mon EOD.
3) Network: Lina — do you want Facilities to provision the temporary test VLAN for direct SSO? Reply here and Marissa will coordinate.
4) Recording: Recording is allowed but not for public distribution. If you record, please mark file as internal and share a read-only link to your procurement team only.

Attachments: Visitor_Form.pdf (please fill and return). I will upload the signed NDA to this thread once complete.

Looking forward to hosting — safe travels.

Hannah Schmitt
